oe_v47_ref_mamluk_red_sea_admiralty = {
	age = age_2_renaissance
	block_for_rebel = yes

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = MAM
			has_or_had_tag = YEM
			has_or_had_tag = ORM
			has_or_had_tag = OMA
			owns = location:suez
			owns = location:cairo
			capital ?= { region = region:egypt_region }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			owns = location:suez
			owns = location:alexandria
			owns = location:jeddah
			num_of_ports >= 4
		}
		has_ports = yes
	}

	country_modifier = {
		trade_sea_efficiency = 0.1
		navy_galley_power = 0.12
		naval_range_modifier = 0.2
		global_merchant_capacity_modifier = 0.1
		navy_maintenance_efficiency = -0.06
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.04
		monthly_towards_naval = societal_value_minor_monthly_move
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 12
		if = { limit = { is_ai = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } } add = -6 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed } add = 25 }
		if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = MAM owns = location:suez } add = 18 }
	}

	years = 2
}
